title: Six tons of missing fissionable material at Chernobyl

tellings.quote: >> Six tons of fisionable material that was at the plant, not in the reactors. Was it was at the plant was missing.

plain: A former US Army sergeant, Lyn Buchanan, says that after the 1986 disaster at the Chernobyl nuclear plant in the Soviet Union, six tons of fissionable material, meaning fuel that can sustain a nuclear chain reaction, went missing. According to him, this material was kept elsewhere at the plant, not in the reactors. He says he was personally involved in the matter, and if he is right, a large amount of dangerous nuclear material vanished without the public hearing about it.
